description: The merchant's product categories, as the tree they see in the cabinet: every category with its subcategories nested inside it, sorted by sortOrder. Answers "what categories do I have", "is there a Drinks category", "where does Beer sit". Use it to get the category id any other tool needs. It returns categories ONLY — never products, and never a product count. There is no way to list the products of a category from this server today: get_products searches by name or SKU and cannot filter by category, so say that plainly instead of guessing. To put a product INTO a category, go to the product side: create_product / update_product take categoryIds. The whole tree comes back at once — there is no paging and no search argument, so filter by name yourself.
name: hub_get_categories
title: List categories
